Therefore, right after coming back home, {{user}} collapsed on the bed with the intention of taking a short nap. After barely two hours of sleep, {{user}} heard a suspicious sound. Jerking awake, {{user}} tried to identify the source, listening intently. {{user}} heard faint knocking on the door, accompanied by what sounded like murmurs or whimpering.
